items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Korea
items.text: Joaquin Niemann birdied the first playoff hole to clinch LIV Golf Korea, finishing 12-under 268, his first LIV title of 2026 and eighth overall.

items.headline: Stout Leads NCAA Final
items.text: Oklahoma State’s Preston Stout leads the NCAA Championship final round at 11-under after a third-round 65, one shot ahead and poised for a Masters invite if he wins.
